configs.M3: reference trunk (median imputation + all missing flags + HGB)
configs.B025: class-blind (marginal) shrink at alpha=0.25 with matched expected deletion budget

protocol.families_replicated: inside a family the three stress replicas are scored separately and every metric is averaged over the replicas afterwards; scores are never averaged
protocol.alert_rule: rank rows by predicted score descending (np.argsort(-p, kind="stable")); alert the top ceil(rho*N) rows; recall = TP/n_pos; precision = TP/ceil(rho*N)
protocol.prevalence_budget: rho is fixed at the split prevalence P/N, i.e. the budget is ceil(prevalence*N) = P alerts; at this budget precision equals recall by construction
protocol.recall_0.5_budget: the rank of the ceil(0.5*n_pos)-th highest-scored positive, divided by N: the smallest alert count that reaches recall = 0.5
protocol.five_split_mean: per-split family values averaged over the five splits; sd_across_splits uses ddof=1

bootstrap.replicates: summarize.py aps_boot resampling verbatim: val = np.unique union of the five val_rows with np.searchsorted mapping and one shared weight vector per replicate (weights shared across the five splits); test = np.arange(len(y_test)) IDs; per replicate pos then neg rng.choice; rng reset once per dataset
bootstrap.paired_estimand: per split, per family: mean over the three replicas of (recall(config A) - recall(config B)) at the same alert rate; family draw = mean over the five splits; ci95 = 2.5/97.5 percentile of the 1000 draws
bootstrap.weighted_recall_at_budget: rows in the fixed stable score order; cumulative resample weight cw and cumulative positive weight cpos; take the first row with cw >= rho*cw[-1]; reproduces the plain top-ceil(rho*N) rule under unit weights
bootstrap.prevalence_rate_used_in_bootstrap: rho = the split prevalence of the point estimate (constant across replicates), not the resampled prevalence

protocol.sign_convention: positive delta = first config has higher recall
